description: Surface "unlinked mentions" for a memory — other memories that are semantically related (vector-near + shared entities) but that you have NOT explicitly linked yet. This is Obsidian's killer feature, automated: instead of matching note titles as literal text, it uses embeddings + the entity graph to propose latent connections the agent never made. Auto "similar_to" suggestions are surfaced; existing wikilink/co-occurrence/typed links are excluded. Use it to discover and then confirm real connections (e.g. via memory_extract_entities or a stored link).

id.description: Memory ID to surface unlinked mentions for

limit.description: Maximum number of unlinked mentions to return

min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a mention (0-1)

name: memory_unlinked_mentions
